text: Make the verifier run the commands for every behavior criterion and list them, as D43 requires. One way: change the verifier brief so it must run the commands a behavior criterion names and list them. It may cite Athena's recorded check results only as well as those commands, never instead of them. Another way: when the criterion matches a check that Athena already ran on the same tree, Athena fills in that check's commands itself. Add a test that reproduces the case from 20261024-033933-ta60, where the fmt, clippy and test criterion has an empty commands list.
